vetSays.line: 🛡️ Monique, Raj and August met them at the door — 3 put down. Monique, Raj, August are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? August just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Monique, Raj and August met them at the door — 3 put down. Monique, Raj, August are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Monique just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Monique, August and Delali met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Monique, August, Delali are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Addison and Luis met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Addison, Luis are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🛡️ Addison and Luis met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Addison, Luis are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Addison taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Ava has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Addison is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Luis and Alexei met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Luis, Alexei are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Daniyar was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Alexei taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Alexei drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Luis: "Walked past a good stand of european elder. Worth remembering where."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
